premises.text: Family/friends bill support still largely uses cash and check with a last-mile risk that money never reaches the biller
premises.evidence_span: Once I give them that money, it may not end up at its intended destination

premises.text: Contributors lack visibility into whether others have paid their share
premises.evidence_span: I don't get any visibility if they've paid their part of that bill

premises.text: PayTap lets people collaborate on a bill with funds going directly to the biller
premises.evidence_span: We allow people to collaborate and contribute towards a bill with the money going directly to the biller

premises.text: Users can share bills and pay without signing up, choosing amount and payment method while keeping financial details private
premises.evidence_span: she's able to go to Paytap without signing up for an account

premises.text: Alerts, recurring payments, private-mode shares, and FDIC-insured funds support multi-party bill collaboration
premises.evidence_span: we can set up things like recurring payments

premises.text: Merchant integrations (e.g., Amazon) and biller distribution let merchants offer shared checkout
premises.evidence_span: we're allowing billers and online merchants to offer Paytap to their users so that they can get payments made

value.text: Elegant shared payments where collaborators contribute and money goes straight to the biller
value.evidence_span: we're the definition of elegant organisation for shared payment

secondary_value.text: Remove stress, steps, and hassle of multi-party payments
secondary_value.evidence_span: We take out the stress, the steps, and all the hassle involved in making payments

causal_links.evidence_span: money going directly to the biller
billers and online merchants to offer Paytap to their users
